minutes_text:
LA VERNE YOUTH & FAMILY ACTION COMMITTEE
  Minutes of the Regular Meeting
  April 26, 2022

1. A meeting of the Youth & Family Action Committee was called to order by Chair
  Robin Carder at 6:30 p.m.

2. Executive Board Members present:

  Executive Board
  Robin Carder, Chair – Council Member
  Rick Crosby, Vice Chair – Council Member
  Greg Palatto, BUSD
  Denise Fisher – Resident

  Hollie Savage, LVPD
  Chris Dransfeldt, LVPD
  Joy Lindsay, BUSD
  JR Ranells, City of La Verne
  Ron Serven, Resident
  Gamaliel Polanco, Tri-City
  Charleen Mejia, Resident/Bonita Council PTA

3. Review of Minutes  Minutes for the March 2022 meeting were approved
  with an amendment correcting Vice Chair Crosby
  calling the meeting to order.

4. School Resource Officer  Administrative Lieutenant Chris Dransfeldt provided
  the SRO Report noting tobacco enforcement and
  education efforts. There has been an uptick in
  vaping and additional programs are being introduced
  at Ramona Middle School.

5. Counseling Program  Gamaliel Polanco with Tri-City Mental Health provided
  an update on the school counseling program.
  Gamaliel noted that interns have been at schools since
  November and will wrap up at the end of May.
  Referrals range from attention and focus issues to
  developing social skills related to COVID impacts.

6. LV/SD Ed. Foundation  Resident Ron Serven shared information regarding the
  La Verne San Dimas Education Foundation related to
  wellness programs including the theme of planting
  seeds to nurture and grow wellness so youth can
  thrive.
 Youth & Family Action Committee Minutes April 26, 2022, page 2

7. Public Comment  JR suggested that members be ready to participate in
  a strategic planning session at the June meeting in
  order to plan and prioritize programs for the next
  school year. This will also include discussion on
  budget and fundraising.

  Relative to a youth representative participating on
  YFAC, it was suggested that the group also reach out
  to Chaparral High School.

8. Next Meeting  The next YFAC meeting was scheduled for June 28,
  2022.

9. Adjournment  The meeting was adjourned at 7:10 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

JR Ranells
Assistant to the City Manager
